events.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
events.description: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance. It is contested on methodology, the authors are accused of both alarmism and of publishing a recipe, and the argument stays inside the biosecurity community – but it is a categorically stronger signal than anything published so far. **This is a precursor: it opens the bio gate for the next 4 turns.**

events.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
events.description: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.
